types.name: L visa (tourist)
types.purpose: Tourism in mainland China.
types.note: Number of entries and length of stay are set by the consular officer.

types.name: M visa (business)
types.purpose: Commercial and trade activities.
types.note: Number of entries and length of stay are set by the consular officer.

types.name: F visa (exchanges and visits)
types.purpose: Exchanges, visits, study tours and other non-commercial activities.

types.name: Z visa (work)
types.purpose: Work in China (employment, foreign expert permit, representative office, offshore petroleum operations).
types.note: Apply for a residence permit within 30 days of entry.

types.name: X1 visa (long-term study)
types.purpose: Study in China for more than 180 days.
types.note: Apply for a residence permit within 30 days of entry.

types.name: X2 visa (short-term study)
types.purpose: Study in China for no more than 180 days.
types.note: Official page says "no more than 180 days".

types.name: Q1 visa (family reunion, long)
types.purpose: Family reunion with Chinese citizens or foreign permanent residents of China, or foster care, for more than 180 days.
types.who: Relatives of Chinese citizens or permanent residents
types.note: Apply for a residence permit within 30 days of entry.

types.name: Q2 visa (family visit, short)
types.purpose: Visiting relatives who are Chinese citizens or foreign permanent residents of China, for no more than 180 days.
types.who: Relatives of Chinese citizens or permanent residents

types.name: S1 visa (private affairs, long)
types.purpose: Visiting family members who are foreigners working or studying in China, or other private affairs, for more than 180 days.
types.who: Relatives of foreign workers or students
types.note: Apply for a residence permit within 30 days of entry.

types.name: S2 visa (private affairs, short)
types.purpose: Short visits to family members who are foreigners working or studying in China, or other private matters, up to 180 days.
types.who: Relatives of foreign workers or students

types.name: R visa (talent)
types.purpose: For high-level talent or those with skills urgently needed in China.

types.name: K visa (young science and technology talent)
types.purpose: New ordinary visa category to promote exchanges and cooperation between young science and technology talents from China and other countries.
types.note: Details (eligibility, validity, stay) are published by Chinese embassies and consulates; none checked here.

types.name: G visa (transit)
types.purpose: Transit through China.

types.name: C visa (crew)
types.purpose: International transport crew, cross-border motor vehicle drivers and accompanying family members.

types.name: D visa (permanent residence)
types.purpose: Entry of foreigners approved for permanent residence in China.
types.note: Apply for a residence permit within 30 days of entry.

types.name: J1 visa (resident journalist)
types.purpose: Resident foreign journalists of news organizations stationed in China, for more than 180 days.

types.name: J2 visa (short-term journalist)
types.purpose: Short-term news coverage, no more than 180 days.

types.name: Unilateral visa-free entry
types.purpose: Visa-free entry for business, tourism, visiting family or friends, exchanges or transit.
types.maxValidity: Policy valid through 31 Dec 2026 (per Canada embassy page; Russia reportedly 2027)
types.note: No work, study or news coverage. Days count from the day after entry. Check your country is on the current list.

types.name: 240-hour visa-free transit
types.purpose: Visa-free transit to a third country or region with a confirmed onward ticket, with short-term tourism, business or visits within permitted areas.
types.note: Up to 240 hours (10 days) via 65 open ports. No work, study or news reporting. Counted from 0:00 the day after entry.

types.name: Hainan 30-day visa-free entry
types.purpose: Visa-free entry to Hainan for tourism, business, visits, family visits, medical treatment, conferences, exhibitions and sports.
types.note: Stay only within Hainan. No work or study. Counted from 0:00 the day after entry.

types.name: ASEAN tour group visa-free (Guilin)
types.purpose: Visa-free group tour of Guilin for ASEAN tour groups arranged by a registered Chinese travel agency.
types.who: Groups of 2+ ordinary-passport holders from ASEAN countries
types.note: Up to 144 hours (6 days), group in and group out through Guilin airport, within Guilin only.

types.name: Permanent residence card
types.purpose: Identity document of foreigners approved for permanent residence; with a passport it allows entry and exit.
types.note: Holders must stay in China more than 3 months cumulatively each year unless approved otherwise.
